title: Fray Bentos mill process train
wholeScope: Connected process installation: two large silver vessels, slender process columns, blue stair tower, yellow vessel, ducts, maintenance platforms and overhead trussed pipe rack. Proportions and layout estimated from cleared factory photographs and the known factory site. Existing independent factory buildings and chimney remain separate.
geometryBasis: Original named Planta UPM factory way119015899 plus cleared government process photographs; installation placement and outline explicitly estimated.

Photographs establish two large silver corrugated vessels with a darker lower shell, slender silver process columns, a blue stair casing, white segmented vertical duct, yellow vessel and yellow maintenance crane, open steel platforms and trussed pipe racks.
